about: Solomon’s Egyptian wife presses him to worship her gods, and he is tricked into entering her idol-house; the author then reflects on men undone by women and on whether God forgave Solomon.

sentences.i: He answered her: 'As for them, let them call their gods the things they made with their own hands, by caster (?) and hewer (?), by potter (?) and painter, by engraver and carver. These are not gods; they are the work of human hands: gold and silver, a metal (?) and bronze (?), iron and clay (?) and stone.'
sentences.n: Note ወአውሥኣ ወይቤላ: the subject now is Solomon ('he answered her'). ሎሙሰ: ሎሙ 'to them' + contrastive -ሰ ('as for them'). ይብሉ is a jussive/subjunctive ('let them say'). ዘገብሩ: ዘ- 'which' + 3mp perfect. The craft nouns are agent nouns (the ቀታሊ pattern, as in ሰዓሊ and ገላፊ) introduced by በ- 'by, with'; the trade words ነሃቢ, ጸራቢ, ለሓኵ are UNCERTAIN (?) and the glosses are guesses from the list of materials; ሰዓሊ 'painter/carver', ወቃሪ 'engraver', ገላፊ 'carver' are likelier. The metal names ብርት and ዐረር are uncertain (?): ብርት is not identified, ዐረር is read 'bronze, brass' as in the glossary, as is ልሕኵት 'clay' (?) (the same word recurs in ቀዳሜ ልሕኵቱ, the sentence on Adam). The thought echoes the biblical polemic against idols (e.g. Psalm 115:4, 'silver and gold, the work of human hands').

sentences.i: 'And you call them "our gods" -- these that are not your gods.'
sentences.n: ወትብልዎሙ: ወ- + ትብሉ (2mp of ይቤ 'say, call') + -ዎሙ '3mp them'; 'call X Y' takes a double accusative (አማልክቲነ). ትብልዎሙ is plural ('you all call them'): Solomon addresses the Egyptians generally, not her alone. The shift between 'our' and 'your' gods is odd, and the sense (the Egyptians call them 'ours' though they are not gods at all) is partly inferred (?).

sentences.i: 'But we, for our part, bow to no other, except to the God, the Holy One of Israel, and to our lady Zion, the holy and heavenly ark of the law of God, which he gave us, that we and our descendants after us may bow to her.'
sentences.n: ወንሕነሰ: ወ- + ንሕነ 'we' + contrastive -ሰ. ኢንሰግድ: 1cp imperfect negated. ዘእንበለ 'except, without'. 'Holy One of Israel' (ቅዱሰ እስራኤል) is the title of Isaiah 1:4, among others. Formally ለአምላከ ቅዱሰ እስራኤል is a construct chain ('the God of the Holy One of Israel'); it is read as apposition, 'the God, the Holy One of Israel' (?). ጽዮን here is the Ark itself (ታቦት), the central theology of the book: Zion = the Ark of the Covenant, a heavenly 'lady'. ታቦተ ሕጉ: construct 'ark-of law-his'; -ሁ anticipates ለእግዚኣብሔር. ዘወሀበነ: ዘ- + ወሀበ 'gave' + -ነ 'us'; the relative could refer to the ark or to God (ambiguous). ከመ ንስግድ 'that we may bow' (subjunctive); ላቲ 'to her'.

sentences.i: She answered him: 'As for your lady -- your son, whom you begot, took (?) [her] from a foreign people, one whom it was not commanded you to marry: an Ethiopian woman, who is not of your kind nor near to your country, black, a foreign people.'
sentences.n: This sentence is a crux and the reading is uncertain (?). The ordering ለእግዝእትከሰ ('as for your lady', ለ- topic + contrastive -ሰ) ነሥአ ወልድከ ዘወለድኮ is read as 'your son, whom you begot, took'; the object is not expressed. ዘወለድኮ = ዘ- + ወለድከ (2ms perfect) + -ሁ, contracted to -ኮ: 'whom you begot'. The spelling would equally fit 1cs ወለድኩ + -ኦ ('whom I begot'), which the sense excludes since she is speaking to him. ታውስቡ is plural because the command was given to Israel. ዘኢአዘዘክሙ ከመ ታውስቡ: 'which he did not command you that you marry'; ታውስቡ 2mp subjunctive of አውሰበ 'take as wife'. ኢትዮጵያዊተ is the accusative feminine of 'Ethiopian'. ሕብር 'kind, colour, stock' (?), ቅርብተ 'near one (f.)' (?). ጸሊማን 'dark ones'. The speaker is Pharaoh's daughter.

sentences.i: And while she said this to him, sweetening her words to him, evening and morning, night and day, he still refused her. One day she became beautiful to him, and gracious (?) to him, and honoured, and great in his eyes.
sentences.n: The two እንዘ clauses ('while ...') give circumstances: ትብሎ is the 3fs imperfect of ይቤ (ትብል + -ኦ 'to him'; the subject 'she' = Pharaoh's daughter), and ታስተጣዕም is from አስተጠዐመ, 'make sweet' (ጠዐመ 'taste', ጣዕም 'sweetness'), uncertain (?); the object is understood (her words). የአብያ = 3ms of አበየ 'refuse' + 'her'. ሌሊተ ወመዓልተ 'by night and by day' (adverbial accusative). The four passive-reflexive verbs ተሠነየት, ተምዕዘት, ተከብረት, ተዐበየት (all with ለ- 'to him') mean 'became beautiful / ... / honoured / great'. ተምዕዘት is uncertain (?): I follow the context ('gracious'); it could instead mean 'was angry'. Whether 'one day' (አሐተ ዕለተ) belongs with the refusing or the turning is unmarked in the Geʿez.

sentences.i: He said to her: 'What shall I do? For you have turned your face against me (?); your gaze is not as before, and your appearance is not comely (?). Ask me what I should give you, what you desire, and what I should do for you, so that you make your face kind toward me as before.'
sentences.n: Hard words here: አሕሠምኪ is uncertain (?) -- the form looks like a verb (perhaps a causative of ሐሠመ) with -ኪ, but the sentence is clear from context: her face has turned cold. ነጽሮት 'gaze, look'. ላሕይ 'beauty, appearance' (as in በላሕይ, the Amnon sentence); አዳም as a predicate is read 'comely, pleasing' (?), as the same predicate was read in an earlier part; 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?). ምንተ 'what' (accusative). ሰአልኒ is the imperative 'ask' + -ኒ 'me'; ዘእሁበኪ 'what I give you' (ዘ- + 1cs imperfect); ታሠንዪ is the 2fs subjunctive of አሠነየ 'make good, beautiful'. ከመ ዘትካት 'as before'.

sentences.i: She tied a thread of ... (?) halfway across the doorway of the house of her gods, and brought three locusts, and sat down inside the house of her gods. She said to him: 'Come in to me without breaking the thread, stooping (?), and kill these locusts before me and cut (?) their necks.'
sentences.n: ፈትለ ለይ: 'thread' + ለይ, a material or kind of thread I cannot determine (?). መንፈቀ ኆኅት 'half (of) the door'. ባእ is the imperative of ቦአ 'enter'; ዘእንበለ ትብትክ 'without your breaking' (subjunctive of በተከ 'break, cut'). ደኒነከ is uncertain (?) -- perhaps 'having bent yourself down, stooping'. ቅትሎሙ ... imperative 'kill them'. ክላዕ is uncertain (?): the stem is that of ከለዐ; 'cut off' is a guess; ክሳውዲሆሙ is the plural of ክሳድ 'neck' + 'their'. The test is a trap: it cannot be done without bowing and entering the idol-house, which he has sworn to do whatever she asks.

sentences.i: But Solomon killed no one, except his brother, when he wished to take as wife the wife of his father David, a northern woman (?) named Abishag. And as for the written fault of Solomon, I will explain it to you by what God has revealed to me.
sentences.n: አልቦ ዘቀተለ: 'there is none whom he killed'; the claim sits oddly beside the previous unit, which has Solomon kill Joab and Shimei (the text treats those as carrying out his father's will). እኁሁ 'his brother' is Adonijah, 1 Kings 2:13-25. ያውስብ: 3ms subjunctive of አውሰበ. ሰሜናዊት as printed is the feminine adjective 'northern' (ሰሜን 'north'), so 'a northern woman'. Abishag is called the Shunammite in 1 Kings 1:3 and a link with that name is likely, but the printed word does not say it, so I translate what is printed (?). አቢስ is Abishag (name spelled short). In the last clause ወበእንተሰ is 'but concerning'; በዘ ከሠተ 'by that which he revealed', and the speaker is the narrator ('I') promising an explanation. The run of ፨ marks the end of the chapter.

glossary.ሰሜናዊት: ሰሜናዊ — northern (adjective from ሰሜን 'north', fem.), 'a northern woman' as printed; the context (Abishag, 1 Kings 1:3) suggests 'Shunammite', but that is not what the word says (?)
glossary.ሰጊድ: ሰጊድ — bowing, worship (verbal noun of ሰገደ)
glossary.ስማ: ስም — her name (noun + -ኣ '3fs her', written ስማ)
glossary.ቀተሎ: ቀተለ — he killed him (3m sg perfect + -o, q-t-l)
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
glossary.ቃሎን: ቃል — their words (noun + -ሆን '3fp their', contracted ቃሎን)
glossary.ቅዱሰ: ቅዱስ — holy one (noun/adjective, construct 'holy one of', in ቅዱሰ እስራኤል)
glossary.በለሓኵ: ለሓኪ — by the potter, clay-worker (?) (በ- + agent noun, cf. ልሕኵት 'clay'; the form ለሓኵ is irregular) (?)
glossary.በመንፈቀ: መንፈቅ — in the half of, midway (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በምክረ: ምክር — by the counsel of (በ- + construct)
glossary.በሰማያት: ሰማይ — in the heavens (በ- 'in' + plural noun)
glossary.በብእሲት: ብእሲት — through a woman (በ- + noun, fem.)
glossary.በነሃቢ: ነሃቢ — by the caster (?) (በ- + agent noun, probably of a verb 'to pour, cast'; sense unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.በአማልክቲሆን: አምላክ — through their gods (በ- + plural አማልክት + -ሆን '3fp their')
glossary.በአምላከ: አምላክ — by the God of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በእኅቱ: እኅት — with his sister (በ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — on this account, concerning this (በእንተ + ዝ, preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.በእከየ: እከይ — in the evil of (በ- + construct)
glossary.በእደዊሆሙ: እድ — with their hands (በ- + noun, plural እደው + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በወቃሪ: ወቃሪ — by the engraver (በ- + agent noun of ወቀረ 'engrave, cut') (?)
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
glossary.በጣዕመ: ጣዕም — by the sweetness of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife') · 'strange, foreign' (አማልክተ ባዕድ 'strange gods')
glossary.ብርት: ብርት — (?) a metal or common material; word unconfirmed (compare Amharic ብረት 'iron')
glossary.ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — woman, wife (noun, fem., construct / accusative)
glossary.ቦቶን: በ — through them, by them (preposition በ- 'by, through' + -ቶን '3fp them')
glossary.ተሠነየት: ተሠነየ — she became beautiful, pleasing (3fs perfect, ተ- of ሠነየ)
glossary.ተግህደት: ተገሀደ — she revealed herself, appeared openly (3fs perfect, ተ- reflexive/passive of ገሀደ 'be open, manifest'; printed ተግህደት) (?)
glossary.ተፈጥረ: ተፈጥረ — it was created, brought about (3m sg passive perfect, f-ṭ-r)
glossary.ተፈጥረት: ተፈጥረ — she was created (3fs perfect, passive of ፈጠረ; subject ታቦት) · 'it was brought about' with fem. subject ስሕተተ (ስሕተተ ተባዕት ተፈጥረት 'the error of the man came about')
glossary.ታሠንዪ: አሠነየ — you make good, kind (2fs subjunctive, causative አ- of ሠነየ)
glossary.ታስተጣዕም: አስተጠዐመ — she makes sweet (3fs imperfect; from ጠዐመ 'taste') (?)
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ታውስቡ: አውሰበ — you take a wife, marry (2mp subjunctive, causative አ-, w-s-b)
glossary.ትቤሊ: ይቤ — you (fs) say, have said (2fs of defective ይቤ, ትቤሊ; the -ሊ is the 2fs ending, not '1cs to me') (?)
glossary.ትብሎ: ይቤ — she says to him (3fs imperfect ትብል of defective ይቤ + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ትብትክ: በተከ — you break, cut (2ms subjunctive, G, b-t-k) (?)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, construct state 'sin-of') · accusative object, 'sin' (ያአትት ኀጢአተ 'he takes away sin')
glossary.ኀጺን: ኀጺን — iron (noun; በአፈ ኀጺን 'by the edge of iron', i.e. the sword)
glossary.ኆኅታ: ኆኅት — her door, doorway (noun, fem. + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of')
glossary.ንስግድ: ሰገደ — we worship, let us worship (1cp subjunctive/imperfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ንትዋሰብ: ተዋሰበ — we intermarry (1cp subjunctive, reciprocal ተ- stem of ወሰበ 'take a wife')
glossary.ንነብር: ነበረ — we stay, we will stay (1cp imperfect)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አሐተ: አሐዱ — one (numeral, fem. accusative; አሐተ ብእሲተ 'one woman')
glossary.አሕሠምኪ: አሕሠመ — you have turned (?) (2fs perfect, causative አ- + -ኪ; root and sense unclear) (?)
glossary.አምከሮ: አምከረ — he advised him (3ms perfect, causative አ-, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.አስሐተቶ: አስሐተ — she led him astray (3fs perfect አስሐተት, causative አ- of ሰሐተ, + -ኦ '3ms him', contracted -ቶ)
glossary.አበይኑ: አበይ — greater (?) (comparative adjective, cf. ዐቢይ 'great' + interrogative -ኑ; form irregular) (?)
glossary.አብደ: አብድ — a fool, foolish (noun/adjective, accusative, predicate of ኮነ: 'he became a fool')
glossary.አንበጣ: አንበጣ — locust (noun; collective, accusative after the numeral)
glossary.አዋልደ: ወለት — daughters of (noun, plural አዋልድ, construct)
glossary.አውሥአቶ: አውሥአ — she answered him (3fs perfect, causative አ-, አውሥአት + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.አውሥኣ: አውሥአ — he answered her (3ms perfect, IV/causative, + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.አውረሰነ: አውረሰ — he gave us as inheritance (3ms perfect, causative አ- of ወረሰ 'inherit', + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.አዘዘነ: አዘዘ — he commanded us (3ms perfect, G + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.አዘዞሙ: አዘዘ — he commanded them (3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
glossary.ኢተሐስወኒ: ሐሰወ — you not deceive me (ኢ- + 2ms subjunctive + -ኒ '1cs me', G, ḥ-s-w) (?)
glossary.ኢታውስቡ: አውሰበ — do not take wives (ኢ- + 2mp, prohibition, causative አ-)
glossary.ኢትስሐቱ: ሰሐተ — that you not err, be led astray (ኢ- + 2mp subjunctive, G)
glossary.ኢንሰግድ: ሰገደ — we do not bow (ኢ- 'not' + 1cp imperfect, G, s-g-d)
glossary.ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
glossary.ኢኮነት: ኮነ — she was not (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ኢኮኑ: ኮነ — they were not (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ኢኮንኪ: ኮነ — you are not (ኢ- 'not' + 2fs perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ኢይሠውዕሂ: ሠውዐ — I do not sacrifice, nor (ኢ- + imperfect + enclitic -ሂ 'either'; the form as printed is ይ-, the 3ms imperfect, though the subject is አነ 'I' (1cs would be ኢእሠውዕ); read as 1cs by sense, left as printed) (?)
glossary.ኢይብላዕ: በልዐ — that he not eat; here 'break, void' (a figure) (ኢ- + 3ms subjunctive, G, b-l-ʿ) (?)
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
glossary.እምሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — than Solomon (እም- comparative 'more than' + proper name)
glossary.እምቅድሜሁ: ቅድሜ — before him (እም- + noun 'front' + -ሁ '3ms his'; እምቅድሜሁ 'those before him')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምአንስተ: ብእሲት — from women of (እም- + plural አንስት, construct)
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you') · 'since' of time (እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed')
glossary.እምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — from now on, indeed (እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እኁሁ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እከሥት: ከሠተ — I will reveal, explain (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G)
glossary.እገብር: ገብረ — I do, make (1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
glossary.ኪያሃ: ኪያሃ — her (accusative independent pronoun, 3fs; object of ያኀድጉነ)
glossary.ክሳውዲሆሙ: ክሳድ — their necks (noun, plural ክሳውድ + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
glossary.ኮኖ: ኮነ — it was to him, it became for him (3ms perfect, G, + -ኦ '3ms to him')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወለሰሎሞንሰ: ሰሎሞን — and to Solomon, indeed (ወ- + ለ- + proper name + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወለእግዝእትነ: እግዝእት — and to our lady (ወ- + ለ- + noun, fem. + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወላሕይኪኒ: ላሕይ — and your appearance, complexion (ወ- + noun + -ኪ '2fs your' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወልሕኵት: ልሕኵት — and clay (?) (ወ- + noun, cf. ልሕከ 'knead'; sense unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.ወመሐለ: መሐለ — and he swore (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወመሐሮ: መሐረ — and he forgave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወመዓልተ: መዓልት — and day (ወ- + noun, fem., accusative as adverb)
glossary.ወሠሪዎ: ሠረወ — and having uprooted, driven out (?) (ወ- + a perfect or participial form of ሠረወ 'uproot' with -ዎ; the exact form is unclear) (?)
glossary.ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
glossary.ወሰሎሞንሰ: ሰሎሞን — and Solomon, indeed (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for')
glossary.ወሰአልኒ: ሰአለ — and ask me (ወ- + imperative 2ms, G + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወሰገድከሂ: ሰገደ — and you bowed too (ወ- + 2ms perfect, G + enclitic -ሂ 'too')
glossary.ወስሕተ: ሰሐተ — and he erred (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወቀተሎሙ: ቀተለ — and he killed them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወቅርብተ: ቅርብት — and nearness, one near (?) (ወ- + noun, fem., construct/accusative; cf. ቅሩብ 'near') (?)
glossary.ወቅትሎ: ቀተለ — and kill him (ወ- + imperative 2ms + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወቅትሎሙ: ቀተለ — and kill them (ወ- + imperative 2ms + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወበሥነ: ሥን — and by the beauty of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወበሰዓሊ: ሰዓሊ — and by the painter, carver of images (ወ- በ- + agent noun of ሰዐለ 'draw, carve an image')
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበእንተሰ: በእንተ — and concerning indeed (ወ- + በእንተ + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወበይእቲ: ይእቲ — and through that, through her (ወ- + በ- + 3fs pronoun/demonstrative)
glossary.ወበገላፊ: ገላፊ — and by the carver, sculptor (ወ- በ- + agent noun of ገልፈ 'carve, scrape')
glossary.ወበጣዕመ: ጣዕም — and by the sweetness of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወበጸራቢ: ጸራቢ — and by the hewer, stone-cutter (?) (ወ- በ- + agent noun, cf. ጸረበ; sense unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.ወተምዕዘት: ተምዕዘ — and she became gracious, charming (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect, ተ- stem; root unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.ወተከብረት: ተከብረ — and she was honoured (ወ- + 3fs perfect, ተ- passive of ከበረ)
glossary.ወተዐበየት: ተዐበየ — and she grew great, was exalted (ወ- + 3fs perfect, ተ- of ዐበየ)
glossary.ወተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — and it was written (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ተ- passive of ጸሐፈ)
glossary.ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወትብልዎሙ: ብህለ — and you call them (ወ- + 2mp imperfect ትብሉ + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወኆለቈ: ኆለቈ — and he counted (ወ- + 3ms perfect, quadriliteral)
glossary.ወነስሐ: ነስሐ — and he repented (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወነበረት: ነበረ — and she sat, dwelt (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወነግሀ: ነግህ — and morning (ወ- + noun, accusative as adverb)
glossary.ወነጽሮትኪኒ: ነጽሮት — and your gaze (ወ- + verbal noun, fem., of ነጸረ 'look' + -ኪ '2fs your' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወአምጽአት: አምጽአ — and she brought (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative አ- of መጽአ)
glossary.ወአርመመት: አርመመ — and she was silent (ወ- + 3fs perfect of አርመመ 'be silent', a quadriliteral-type verb, not a causative) (?)
glossary.ወአሰረት: አሰረ — and she tied (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወአቅተሎ: አቅተለ — and he had him killed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ቀተለ, q-t-l, + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአውሥኡ: አውሥአ — and they answered (ወ- + causative 3mp perf., w-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወአውሥኣ: አውሥአ — and he answered her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative አ-, + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወአዳምኒ: አዳም — and Adam also (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወኢያውሥአቶ: አውሥአ — and she did not answer him (ወ- + ኢ- + imperfect + -ቶ '3ms him'; as printed ያ-, the 3ms imperfect (3fs would be ታ-), though the subject is she; read as 3fs by sense, left as printed) (?)
glossary.ወኢይሰግድሂ: ሰገደ — and I do not bow, nor (ወ- + ኢ- + imperfect + enclitic -ሂ 'either'; as printed ይ-, the 3ms imperfect, though the subject is አነ 'I'; read as 1cs by sense, left as printed) (?)
glossary.ወኢይገብር: ገብረ — and I will not do (ወ- + ኢ- + imperfect, G; as printed ይ-, the 3ms imperfect, though the subject is አነ 'I'; read as 1cs by sense, left as printed) (?)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወክላዕ: ከለዐ — and cut off (?) (ወ- + imperative 2ms; verb unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
glossary.ወወሀቦሙ: ወሀበ — and he gave them (ወ- + 3m sg perfect + -omu, w-h-b)
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዘመድክሙ: ዘመድ — and your kin (ወ- + noun + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.ወዘርእነ: ዘርእ — and our seed, descendants (ወ- + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘእገብር: ገብረ — and what I do (ወ- + ዘ- + 1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
glossary.ወደገመ: ደገመ — and he repeated (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
glossary.ዘሀገረ: ሀገር — of a land, a land of (ዘ- + noun, accusative/construct)
glossary.ዘረገመኒ: ረገመ — he who cursed me (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘሰአለቶ: ሰአለ — what she asked him (ዘ- + 3fs perfect ሰአለት + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — which was written (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, ተ- passive of ጸሐፈ)
glossary.ዘትቤሎ: ይቤ — what she said to him (ዘ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ዘትካት: ትካት — of establishment, the established (?) (ዘ- + noun; cf. ተከለ 'plant, establish') (?) · ከመ ዘትካት 'as before, as formerly' (idiom, of the face and gaze) (?)
glossary.ዘትፈቅዲ: ፈቀደ — what you wish (ዘ- + 2fs imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘአምሐለቶ: አምሐለ — which she made him swear (ዘ- + 3fs perfect አምሐለት, causative አ- of መሐለ 'swear', + -ኦ '3ms him', contracted -ቶ; a 3ms 'he made her swear' would be written አምሐሎ, so is not the printed form) (?)
glossary.ዘኢአዘዘክሙ: አዘዘ — which he did not command you (ዘ- relative + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ዘእሁበኪ: ወሀበ — what I give you (ዘ- + 1cs imperfect + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ዘእምነኪር: ነኪር — from a foreign, of a foreign (ዘ- + እም- 'from' + adjective/noun 'foreign, strange')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘወሀበነ: ወሀበ — which gave us (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ነ 'us')
glossary.ዘወለድኮ: ወለደ — whom you begot (ዘ- relative + 2ms perfect ወለድከ + -ኦ '3ms him', contracted -ኮ; the spelling would equally fit 1cs ወለድኩ + -ኦ 'whom I begot', which the sense excludes), G
glossary.ዘገብሩ: ገብረ — which they made (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘፈቀደት: ፈቀደ — what she wished (ዘ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ዚአሃ: ዚአ — hers, of her (possessive ዚአ + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.የሀባ: ወሀበ — he give her (3ms subjunctive + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.የአብያ: አበየ — he will refuse her/it (3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-b-y + -ኣ '3fs it', anticipating ለኅሊናሁ)
glossary.የዐቢ: ዐበየ — he is great, greater (3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ያምልኩ: አምለከ — that they worship, serve (3mp subjunctive)
glossary.ያአምር: አእመረ — he knows, discerns (3ms imperfect, caus., ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ያውስብ: አውሰበ — that he take as wife (3ms subjunctive, causative አ-)
glossary.ያደክማ: አደከመ — they weaken (3fp imperfect, causative አ-, d-k-m)
glossary.ይመውትኒ: ሞተ — while he is dying (3ms imperfect, G + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ይምሕሮኑ: መሐረ — does he forgive him? (3ms imperfect/subjunctive + -ኦ '3ms him' + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.ይሤኒ: ሠነየ — he is handsome, beautiful (3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይኄይስ: ኀየሰ — he is better (3ms imperfect, G) · impersonal 'it is better' (ይኄይስ ዝየ ንብረት 'it is better to live here')
glossary.ይንሥኣ: ነሥአ — that he take her (3ms subjunctive, G + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ይጠብብ: ጠበበ — he is wise (3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-b-b)
glossary.ይጸንዕ: ጸንዐ — he is strong (3ms imperfect, ṣ-n-ʿ)
glossary.ይጸድቅ: ጸድቀ — he is righteous (3ms imperfect, G, ṣ-d-q)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ደኒነከ: ደኒን — you bending, stooping (?) (adjective/participle + -ከ '2ms you'; root unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh'
glossary.ጌጋዩ: ጌጋይ — his fault (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted ጌጋዩ)
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct)
glossary.ጠቢብ: ጠቢብ — wise, a wise man (adjective used as noun)
glossary.ጽዮንሂ: ጽዮን — Zion too, and as for Zion (proper name + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.፯: ፯ — 7, spoken ሰብዐቱ (säbʿatu) 'seven'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'seven' (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
glossary.፷፬: ፷፬ — spoken ስሳ ወአርባዕቱ (səsa wä-ʾärbaʿtu) 'sixty-four' (numeral; chapter number: ፷ 60 + ፬ 4)
glossary.፷፭: ፷፭ — spoken ስሳ ወኀምስቱ (səsa wä-ḫaməstu) 'sixty-five' (numeral; chapter number: ፷ 60 + ፭ 5)
